title: Restricted Styles Page
description: Exercises the per-region slate style allow-list (#295): the page's items region disallows blockquote, `b` and `del`, and spells bold `strong` — so the toolbar hides Blockquote and Strikethrough, a pasted <blockquote> lands as a paragraph, the stored `b` normalizes on load, and a `del` transform driven straight at the admin is refused.
